The percentage of students of Arts faculty doing costing only is (round to the nearest integer) :
solution:
**Given:**

Total students doing Costing in Arts faculty = Girls (25) + Boys (120)

Total students in Arts faculty = Business Management (Girls 25 + Boys 45) + Typewriting (Girls 23 + Boys 186) + Costing (Girls 25 + Boys 120) + Typewriting & Costing (Girls 12 + Boys 100)

**Formula Used:**

Percentage = (Part/Whole) × 100

**Calculation:**

Total students doing Costing in Arts = 25 + 120 = 145

Total students in Arts = (25 + 45) + (23 + 186) + (25 + 120) + (12 + 100)

Total students in Arts = 70 + 209 + 145 + 112

Total students in Arts = 536

Percentage of students doing Costing only in Arts = (145/536) × 100

Percentage of students doing Costing only in Arts ≈ 27%

**The percentage of students of Arts faculty doing costing only is 27%.**
